title: The Voices Beneath the Water · Episode 16: What the Storm Left
description: After the storm, Jon wants a quick all-clear so the community can resume daily life. An directs a ground-level inspection; the water protection holds, but the learning centre's roof and furniture need work. Jon stops treating speed as proof of competence. They agree to reopen the centre only after trained inspection and repair.
